title: Broadband Polarization Compensation with Link Segment Reconstruction for Quantum Optical Links
summary: Polarization-encoded quantum communication requires compensation of polarization transformations induced by the optical links. If the compensator is embedded between two channel segments, the transformations before and after the compensator must be treated separately. Moreover, standard three-wave-plate polarization controllers can become non-universal when their retardances deviate from their ideal values.
